heading_path: Part 13—Importation of goods infringing Australian trade marks
136A  Seized goods not claimed are forfeited
text: (1) Seized goods are forfeited to the Commonwealth if a claim for the release of the goods is not made within the claim period for the goods. Note: For seized goods and claim period see section 6. (2) However, if the ComptrollerGeneral of Customs allows a late claim for the goods (see section 136B), the goods are taken not to have been forfeited.
